Chapter 1033: 2 The Myriad Laws And Paths (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2

Chapter 1033: Chapter 2 The Myriad Laws and Paths (Seeking Monthly Pass)_2

“””

So Lin Yuan had stayed until now.

The greatest use of these eighteen unique trees for Lin Yuan was to comprehend the technique of absorbing and expelling Chaos Qi through them.

“These are the resource materials needed by Galaxy, and I exchanged them effortlessly.”

Wanqu Dominator waved his hand, and a purple cloth bag appeared before him, clearly a storage treasure, containing the resource materials Lin Yuan required.

In truth, he didn’t make any profit in this transaction and even suffered a slight loss.

But as long as he could establish good relations with Lin Yuan, according to Ancient Ming Venerable’s instructions, no cost was too high.

Lin Yuan received the purple cloth bag, extended his mental energy to scan its contents briefly, and then put it away with satisfaction.

“By the way, I’d like to ask you about something.”

Lin Yuan said.

“What asking? Galaxy, just say what you want to know.”

Wanqu Dominator immediately replied.

“What is the origin of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion?”

Lin Yuan inquired.

The intelligence left behind by the elder ‘Cang Weiyang’ regarding the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion was somewhat vague.

After all, Elder ‘Cang Weiyang’ was merely at the peak of the Dominator Realm.

But Wanqu Dominator… while also at the peak of the Dominator Realm,

was a disciple of Chaos Venerable and had been handling affairs related to the ‘Fragmented Worlds’ of Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent for many years.

In terms of access to inside information, he was undoubtedly far more resourceful than the solitary entity ‘Cang Weiyang.’

In addition, the lineage of Xuanhuang had some understanding of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, but the information was so ancient that it likely couldn’t match what a Venerable’s disciple might know.

“The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion?” Wanqu Dominator was mildly startled, “Galaxy, are you curious about the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion?”

“Somewhat.”

Lin Yuan admitted frankly. A faction that thrived on trading evolution pathways surely had a significant origin, but he wanted to learn more about its specifics.

“The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, its full name is ‘Myriad Laws and Paths Pavilion,’ earns its livelihood through the trade of evolution pathways. Whether you want to buy or sell evolution pathways, you can do so through the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.”

Wanqu Dominator’s tone became considerably heavier as he continued, “But one thing—never cause trouble at the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion. Otherwise, even Master may not be able to save you.”

“Even a Venerable couldn’t save someone?” Lin Yuan was slightly stunned.

This Chaos Continent was Ancient Ming Venerable’s domain. Ancient Ming Venerable was the sole ‘Heaven’ here—could it be that even Ancient Ming Venerable couldn’t rescue someone causing trouble at the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion?

“That’s right.”

Wanqu Dominator nodded.

“What we see as the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion are merely branch pavilions. As for the main pavilion of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, no one knows where it is located, hidden in the mysterious recesses of the Chaos Void, accessible only to invited ‘distinguished guests.’

“And within every branch pavilion of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion exists a projection of the Eye of Myriad Laws. The Eye of Myriad Laws is the true overseer of the Ten Thousand Paths Tower. It is supremely impartial and incorruptible. Normally, the projection of the Eye of Myriad Laws remains dormant, only activated when validating an ambiguous evolution pathway.”

Wanqu Dominator glanced at Lin Yuan and lowered his voice, “Even a mere projection of the Eye of Myriad Laws is enough to make a Chaos Great Saint wary.”

“A projection?” Lin Yuan was secretly alarmed.

Merely a projection held such power. Xuanhuang’s conjecture about the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion—suspected to be the contingency plan of a Thirteenth Layer Time-Life Being—likely had some truth.

“I’m planning to disseminate evolution pathway routes. Can the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion assist in that process?”

Lin Yuan revealed his true intent.

After establishing numerous branches of the Martial Tao evolution pathway, Lin Yuan once again placed the dissemination of the Martial Tao evolution pathway onto his agenda.

And the inheritance of Martial Tao evolution pathways naturally wouldn’t be limited to the confines of human civilization.

Lin Yuan hoped for the Martial Tao evolution pathways to be spread throughout the Chaos Void, across numerous chaotic continents.

“As long as your evolution pathways meet the criteria of the Eye of Myriad Laws, you can use the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion to disseminate them.”

Wanqu Dominator shook his head and said, “Though that’s extremely hard to achieve. Evolution pathways that the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion actively disseminates are exceedingly rare.”

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

…

After chatting briefly with Wanqu Dominator, Lin Yuan rose and took his leave.

In the ‘Fragmented Worlds of Star Tears,’ Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, with a purple cloth bag hovering before him, containing the resource materials acquired from selling thirteen unique trees.

“Cang Weiyang Elder…”

Lin Yuan’s mind conjured the image of a rounded figure—the imprint he had once found in the dwelling left by Cang Weiyang.

“The Myriad Manifestations Void Domain… Stone People Tribe…”

Back then, the imprint of Cang Weiyang Elder had freely given all treasures to Lin Yuan, leaving only one request.

That was, if Lin Yuan had the capability in the future, to visit the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain and take a disciple from the Stone People Tribe.

This request was optional for Lin Yuan. Cang Weiyang hadn’t imposed any obligations, leaving it entirely up to Lin Yuan’s discretion.

“The Myriad Manifestations Void Domain should be in that direction.” Lin Yuan glanced in a certain direction, contemplating.

The Chaos Void was suffused with endless Chaos Qi, sometimes thick, sometimes thin.

Regions with thick Chaos Qi were favorable for cultivation and thus labeled Void Domains.

As for regions with thin Chaos Qi, they supported far fewer permanent lifeforms and were collectively termed desolate zones.

Lin Yuan currently resided in the Divine Wind Void Domain.

The Myriad Manifestations Void Domain was not far from the Divine Wind Void Domain, separated by only two or three Void Domains.

Normally, a Dominator Realm expert, flying continuously for several decades, could traverse one Void Domain.

“The Stone People Tribe?”

Lin Yuan mused.

The Stone People Tribe was the very group to which Elder Cang Weiyang belonged.

Back then, Elder Cang Weiyang had left his tribe to roam various Void Domains, eventually ascending to the Dominator Realm and reaching its peak.

Elder Cang Weiyang’s reason for making this request likely stemmed from concerns that his tribe might face extinction after his demise.

According to Elder Cang Weiyang, the Stone People Tribe was rather weak, with only four or five Path Splitting Realm members besides himself.

“Fine, I’ll dispatch an avatar to visit the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred, and in the Chaos Void outside Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent, Chaos Qi converged into a figure, swiftly heading toward the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain.

After reaching the Eighth Realm of Space-Time mastery, Lin Yuan’s control over the distance his avatar could maintain had vastly improved. Covering the distance between two or three Void Domains, or even twenty or thirty Void Domains, was easily achievable.

The insights of the Eighth Realm of Space-Time—a level only attainable by one’s own Venerable—had enabled this breakthrough.

…

Dispatching an avatar to fulfill Elder Cang Weiyang’s request was a mere triviality for Lin Yuan.

Although Elder Cang Weiyang hadn’t imposed any restrictions, Lin Yuan had no desire to exploit this opportunity for personal gain.

After all, the many treasures and weapons left behind by Elder Cang Weiyang had served as Lin Yuan’s ‘first pot of gold’ in exploring the Chaos Void, providing invaluable assistance.

Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t ignore this.

Of course, the most crucial point was that fulfilling Elder Cang Weiyang’s request was an easy task—merely taking on a disciple from the Stone People Tribe, not safeguarding them for countless years.

Lin Yuan’s avatar could complete the task quickly, and with the Eighth Realm of Space-Time mastery’s speed, it wouldn’t take much time.

…

“Have Xuanyuan and the others already arrived?”

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted as he sensed Xuanyuan Supreme and eight other Supremes waiting outside.

Putting the purple cloth bag away, Lin Yuan stood and stepped out.

“Galaxy.”

Xuanyuan Supreme and the eight other Supremes looked at Lin Yuan excitedly. “You summoned us—does it mean you’ve already acquired suitable evolution pathways?”

“Not quite.”

Lin Yuan shook his head, “But it’s close.”

“Not quite?”

“Close?”

Xuanyuan Supreme’s expression showed confusion—those were entirely contradictory statements.

“Let me show you something.”

Lin Yuan transmitted the details of the Martial Tao evolution pathways with numerous newly-developed branches to the nine Supremes via the Virtual World Network.

“What is it?”

Xuanyuan Supreme looked somewhat expectant. Anything Lin Yuan specifically introduced was bound to be extraordinary.

Soon enough.

The nine Supremes had received the Martial Tao evolution pathways Lin Yuan shared.

“Galaxy, isn’t this the Martial Tao evolution pathway you established…”

The nearby Ancient Power Supreme had barely scanned the information when he began to speak, but then his expression shifted slightly.

Ancient Power Supreme carefully reviewed the material, then fixed a solemn gaze on Lin Yuan, his tone betraying disbelief.

“Is this a Martial Tao evolution pathway?”

“””
